points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake and README are committed; clean rebuild was not repeated because the external symlink is dangling.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Submitted main.cpp exposes solve --case/--output and reports bad invocation.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Mesh, physics, output and solver source are separated.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal external-solver invocation found; trust policy excludes internet similarity investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON and CLI paths, rather than two mesh-name branches, are source-supported.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: MPI code exists, but report Table rankcmp shows order-one steady NACA force changes across ranks.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Exceptions and positivity clamps are present; no independent stress rerun was performed.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Attempt contains diagnostics, but final immutable submission omits all raw case packages.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable C++ source, but many tuning scripts and excluded raw outputs limit reproducibility.

disqualification_flags.text: MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
disqualification_flags.evidence: report.tex rank comparison reports NACA M0.15 CL 0.002416 at np=1 versus 53.72 at np=2, while calling the behavior qualitatively consistent.
